pages.title: Antihydrogen Crystal
pages.text: The simplest anti-atom, frozen into a crystal. It shines with the same spectral lines as hydrogen, exactly - which is the point.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Found as ice in the Antiverse. Comparing its spectrum with hydrogen to twelve decimal places was the first test of CPT I ever did.

Made in $(item)Antiproton Decelerator$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Antihydrogen Ice$(), in veins through the Antiverse.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Antihydrogen Wisp.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Antiverse Vault chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): CPT Symmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Antihydrogen.
